title: 아슬아슬한 순간: 하마터면 ~할 뻔했어요
objective: By the end, you can make -을/ㄹ 뻔했어요 with any verb and use it, with or without 하마터면, to talk about a close call.
summary: Learn to use -을 뻔하다 to say that something bad almost happened but did not.

task.title: Practice -을 뻔하다
task.line: Read each item, then write, choose, correct, or order the words as the instruction says.

forms.when: The verb stem ends in a vowel (넘어지다, 가다, 놓치다).
forms.means: Something almost happened, but it did not.
forms.exampleMeaning: The road was slippery, so I almost fell (but I didn't).

forms.when: The verb stem ends in a consonant other than ㄹ (잊다, 먹다, 늦다). Irregular verbs change first: ㄷ → ㄹ (듣다 → 들을 뻔했다), ㅂ → 우 + ㄹ (돕다 → 도울 뻔했다), ㅅ drops (낫다 → 나을 뻔했다).
forms.means: Something almost happened, but it did not.
forms.exampleMeaning: I was busy, so I almost forgot my mom's birthday.

forms.when: The stem already ends in ㄹ (울다, 열다, 잠들다). Do not add 을.
forms.means: Something almost happened, but it did not.
forms.exampleMeaning: The movie was so sad that I almost cried.

forms.when: You escaped something bad or dangerous by a little.
forms.means: Adds the feeling 'Phew, that was close!'
forms.exampleMeaning: I very nearly missed the last train.

forms.when: Casual talk, to exaggerate a strong feeling (hungry, bored, scared).
forms.means: It was so bad that I felt I could die. Not a real danger.
forms.example: 회의가 너무 길어서 지루해 죽을 뻔했어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: The meeting was so long I was bored to death.

watchOut: 잃어버렸을 뻔했어요 (X) → 잃어버릴 뻔했어요 (O): Do not put past tense on the verb. Only 뻔하다 becomes past: 뻔했어요.
문을 열을 뻔했어요 (X) → 문을 열 뻔했어요 (O): With a ㄹ stem, keep ㄹ and add nothing.
버스를 놓칠 뻔했어요. 그래서 택시를 탔어요. (X) → 버스를 놓쳤어요. 그래서 택시를 탔어요. (O): -을 뻔했어요 means it did NOT happen. If it really happened, use the normal past tense.
하마터면 이길 뻔했어요 (X) → 하마터면 질 뻔했어요 (O): Use 하마터면 only for bad things you escaped, not for good things you missed.
exercises: Change the word in brackets to -을/ㄹ 뻔했어요: ① 버스에서 휴대폰을 보다가 내릴 역을 ____. (지나치다) ② 유통기한이 지난 우유를 ____. (먹다) ③ 너무 피곤해서 운전하다가 ____. (잠들다)
Did it really happen? Write Yes or No: ① 계단에서 미끄러질 뻔했어요. ② 지하철에서 우산을 잃어버렸어요. ③ 하마터면 시험에 떨어질 뻔했어요.
Find the mistake and correct it: ① 어제 길에서 자전거하고 부딪쳤을 뻔했어요. ② 회의가 지루해서 졸을 뻔했어요. ③ 오늘 아침에 늦게 일어나서 수업에 늦을 뻔해요.
Which sentence is natural? Choose a or b: a. 하마터면 장학금을 받을 뻔했어요. b. 하마터면 장학금을 못 받을 뻔했어요.
Put the words in order to make one sentence: 뻔했어요 / 잘못 / 하마터면 / 탈 / 기차를
Complete B's answer with the exaggeration you learned: A: 점심 못 먹었어요? B: 네, 오후 내내 너무 배고파서 ____.
answers: ① 지나칠 뻔했어요 ② 먹을 뻔했어요 ③ 잠들 뻔했어요
① No ② Yes ③ No
① 부딪쳤을 뻔했어요 → 부딪칠 뻔했어요 ② 졸을 뻔했어요 → 졸 뻔했어요 ③ 늦을 뻔해요 → 늦을 뻔했어요
하마터면 기차를 잘못 탈 뻔했어요. (기차를 하마터면 잘못 탈 뻔했어요.)
